prompt:
Image 1 is a flat lay of a Basketball kit, photographed from the front.

Photograph THAT SAME KIT from the BACK — the same garments, turned over:
- the shirt, laid flat and face DOWN, so its back is what you see
- the shorts below it, also turned so their back is what you see
EXACTLY ONE of each. No socks, no shoes, no ball, nothing else in the frame.

Everything carries over from image 1 unchanged: the same colours, the same fabric, the
same cut, the same sleeve length, the same collar, and above all the SAME PANELS AND
TRIM — a stripe, a panel or a piping that exists on the front continues around to the
back exactly as the garment's construction would carry it. Nothing is added that image 1
does not have, and nothing that image 1 has quietly disappears.

THE KIT — these are settled decisions, not suggestions. Do not substitute anything.
- shirt: Deep blue short-sleeved basketball jersey. Light blue piping around the V-neck collar and around both armholes, and a light blue panel running down each side from the armhole to the hem. FRONT: the club badge small on the wearer's LEFT chest, and the number 12 in light blue with a white outline centred on the chest below the neckline. BACK: the number 12 large in light blue with a white outline, and NO badge. No club name, no sponsor and no lettering of any kind anywhere on it.
- shorts: Deep blue basketball shorts ending above the knee, with light blue trim along the hem and the club badge small on the wearer's LEFT leg. Plain otherwise, and no lettering.
- socks: Black crew socks, plain, with no logo.
- footwear: Dark blue and white high-top basketball sneakers with a white swoosh on the side — the same pair he wears in the photographs, shown clean. The same pair in every shot.
- equipment: A standard orange basketball with black seams, clean. The same ball in every shot.
- Where an item above is described from the athlete's own photographs, any manufacturer's
  logo it genuinely carries stays on it — that is their real clothing.
- The club crest goes small on the LEFT CHEST, about three fingers wide.

THE BACK OF THE SHIRT carries the squad number 11 and NOTHING ELSE:
no club badge, no crest, no club name, no player name, no sponsor, no letters of any
kind, and nothing inside, under or beside the numerals.

Hard requirements:
- Everything is BRAND NEW and immaculate: no dirt, no scuffs, no wear, no sweat marks.
- Flat lay from directly overhead. No mannequin, no person, no body, no hanger, no rail.
- The same plain light grey surface and the same even lighting as image 1.
- No text of any kind beyond the number, no labels, no neck tag, no watermark.
- Sharp throughout, photographic, print quality. Square image.
